question: Which of the following shortcuts is used to Split the document window?
solution:
The correct answer is __Ctrl + Alt + S****.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ctrl + Alt + S__ is the shortcut key to split the document window in Microsoft Word.
 
• Splitting the document window allows users to view and edit different parts of the document simultaneously.
 
• This feature is particularly useful for comparing sections or copying content between different parts of a document.
 
• To remove the split, you can press Ctrl + Alt + S again or drag the split bar to the top or bottom of the window.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Shortcut Keys:**
 
 
• **Ctrl + Y:** Redo the last action.
 
• **Ctrl + Alt + C:** Used to insert a copyright symbol in some versions of Microsoft Word.
 
• **Alt + Shift + C:** Used to close the header and footer section in a document.
